$comment: compares a `jest --json` run against these minimums and fails when fewer suites or
tests execute than recorded, which is how a test file that silently stopped running
(parse error, unmatched glob, skipped suite) is caught.
minSuites was measured with `jest --listTests --exclude-isolated-suites` on top of
commit b9379f75 (686 collected suites in total, minus the 4 isolated ones).
minTests is null until the first known-good full CI run records it with
`quarantined` lists suites that are known-red/flaky for reasons unrelated to #457;
they are reported as warnings instead of failures so the gate is usable from day one.
Removing an entry from `quarantined` is the way to make its suite blocking again.

ci.description: npm run test:ci — both Jest projects, isolated process-boundary suites excluded.

isolated.description: npm run test:isolated — child-process suites, serial, dedicated CI job.
